about_the_game:
Miner Crysis is a 2D sci-fi mining adventure where you pilot a customizable drill-ship beneath the surface of a dying moon. With only an AI companion to guide you after being abandoned, you must uncover the moon’s secrets and survive its many dangers.

Features:

  • Deep Mining Exploration: Dig through layers of destructible terrain in a vast, interconnected underground world filled with hidden chambers, rare resources, and ancient secrets.

  • Ship Customization & Upgrades: Improve your drill-ship with enhanced drills, armor plating, boosters, and weapons. Tailor your build to fit your playstyle—faster, tougher, or more heavily armed.

  • Resource Gathering & Trading: Extract valuable ores and trade them at underground vendors for credits to purchase upgrades, fuel, and repair parts.

  • Combat & Alien Threats: Face hostile subterranean creatures, defense drones, and environmental hazards. Use your weapons strategically to survive.

  • Radiation & Survival Mechanics: Venture deeper and face rising eternium radiation levels. Equip shielding and monitor your ship’s vitals to avoid a quick death.

  • Story & Lore: Piece together the mystery of the collapsing moon through datapads, NPC dialogue, and environmental storytelling. Discover what happened—and whether you can stop it from happening again.

  • Quests & Side Missions: Complete main story objectives and optional quests given by robotic allies scattered across the depths.

  • Laser-Sealed Doors & Secret Rooms: Unlock new areas using datapads found in hidden rooms or dropped by bosses.

The moon is on the brink of collapse—its core held together by a volatile crystal-powered device. Can you unlock its secrets before everything comes crashing down?
